newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat basis steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat basis steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat basis values were mostly unchanged in quiet market activity, grain dealers said.

Export demand was slow. Mexico bought about 2,200 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat late Thursday for early April shipment but were expected to re-tender early next week for between 8,000 and 28,000 tonnes U.S. HRW wheat.
Results of Iraq's tender early this week for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat were not expected until Monday, exporters said.
